name: After § 22
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 22a. Stresses that no expenditure under the next MFF should directly or indirectly support fossil fuels, and insists that all EU expenditure be fully aligned with the EU’s climate objectives and the progressive phase-out of fossil fuels;
